items.source_excerpt: Details about a new steel trade measure from 1 July 2026, which limits tariff-free steel import quota volumes. On 19 March 2026, the government announced a new steel trade measure , taking effect from 1 July 2026. This measure has been implemented using powers in the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2018 , as amended. The government has carried out a programme of intensive industry engagement since the announcement. We have also engaged closely with the European Union ( EU ) ahead of their new steel trade measure coming into effect and agreed an approach that reflects the UK and EU ’s highly interconnected supply chains. From 1 July 2026, the government is limiting tariff-free steel imports, reducing overall quota volumes by 51% compared with the steel safeguard measure. Any imports above these levels will face a 50% tariff. The measure applies to imports of steel products that can also be made in the UK. items.title_zh: CBAM 证书操作说明：2026 年排放于 2027 年购证清缴
items.title_en: CBAM certificate factsheet: 2026 emissions settled in 2027
items.summary_zh: 9 月 30 日发布的说明：证书拟于 2027 年 2 月 1 日开售；2026 年无季度持证义务，相关证书须于 2027 年 9 月 30 日前购买并清缴。此后季度末持证覆盖至少 50% 的年内累计隐含排放；最终数量按适用规则调整。
items.summary_en: The 30 September factsheet schedules sales for 1 February 2027. No quarterly holding obligation applies in 2026; certificates for that year's emissions must be purchased and surrendered by 30 September 2027. Subsequent quarter-end holdings cover at least 50% of year-to-date embedded emissions, subject to applicable adjustments.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：与进口商分别安排 2026 年排放资料和 2027 年资金；购证延后不代表 2026 年进口免除碳成本。
items.impact_en: Assessment: separate 2026 emissions documentation from 2027 funding. Deferred certificate purchases do not exempt 2026 imports from carbon costs.
items.source_excerpt: How CBAM certificates work Starting in 2027, CBAM importers must submit their annual CBAM declaration by 30 September for imports of CBAM goods during the preceding year. The CBAM declaration reports the quantity of goods imported, their embedded emissions, and the corresponding number of certificates. General publications 30 September 2026 English Download (2.97 MB - PDF)
items.coverage: Official two-page factsheet reviewed; explanatory guidance, not a new regulation.

items.title_zh: GFSEC 通过密尔沃基框架：加强贸易救济、反规避与熔炼浇铸地透明度
items.title_en: GFSEC Milwaukee Framework: trade remedies, anti-circumvention and melt-and-pour transparency
items.title_original: Ambassador Greer Issues Statement Following the Ministerial Meeting of the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity
items.summary_zh: USTR 9 月 30 日确认 GFSEC 部长会议通过联合行动框架。正式文件提出在各自法律框架下减少扭曲市场的支持、强化熔炼浇铸地数据、开展反倾销/反补贴/保障措施调查并协调反规避；各成员实施力度可因国内情况不同。
items.summary_en: USTR confirmed agreement on 30 September. The framework calls for reducing distortive support, improving melt-and-pour data, trade-remedy investigations and coordinated anti-circumvention, within national legal frameworks; implementation may differ by member.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：中国钢材及含钢下游产品的多市场贸易救济与溯源风险上升。准备真实熔炼浇铸地、生产商及加工链证明，关注各国后续公告；框架本身没有设定统一新增税率，也不是 G20 全体已一致加税。
items.impact_en: Assessment: monitor trade-remedy and traceability risks across markets. Prepare melt-and-pour and processing-chain evidence and check subsequent national measures. The framework itself sets no uniform new tariff and is not a unanimous G20 tariff decision.
items.source_excerpt: MILWAUKEE – Today, Ambassador Jamieson Greer chaired the Ministerial Meeting of the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity, which reached consensus on a comprehensive framework for joint action (“the Milwaukee Framework”). Ambassador Greer highlighted the effective actions taken by the Trump Administration to address global steel excess capacity and its impacts, including on U.S. manufacturers and workers, and invited like-minded partners to take similar steps to more fully address excess capacity and the global market distortions it causes. Ambassador Greer Issues Statement Following the Ministerial Meeting of the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity “Under President Trump, the U.S. steel industry is undergoing a renaissance on the strength of tariffs, trade deals, favorable tax treatment, improved energy policy, and the American entrepreneurial spirit,” said Ambassador Greer . “If like-minded partners adopt similar policies, they can hold accountable those countries that are contrib…
items.coverage: USTR release and final GFSEC framework/ministerial statement checked.

items.title_original: Rio Tinto commissions carbon-capture trial at China's Shougang steel plant
items.summary_zh: 力拓 9 月 28 日公司公告确认首钢京唐高炉煤气碳捕集试验设施投运：设计处理量最高 3,000 立方米/小时，年捕集量最高 10,000 吨 CO₂。项目属于双方 2022 年合作备忘录下的技术研发。

items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：可向客户说明低碳技术进展，但设计捕集量不是已实现减排量，也不能直接换算成某钢卷已核验的 CBAM 排放值。
items.impact_en: Assessment: useful technology evidence for customers; design capture capacity is not achieved abatement or a verified coil-specific CBAM value.
items.coverage: Corporate primary-source release checked; no independent performance verification.

items.title_zh: 欧盟钢铁新规运行情况咨询：10 月 11 日截止，出口商可参与
items.title_en: EU steel regulation monitoring consultation closes 11 October
items.title_original: Monitoring the functioning of the new EU Steel Regulation
items.summary_zh: 欧委会 9 月 28 日启动对条例 (EU) 2026/1384 运行情况的定向咨询，面向上游钢企、下游用户、协会、第三国政府与出口商等。截止为 2026 年 10 月 11 日 23:59（CEST）；不同产品类别可分别提交回复。
items.summary_en: The Commission opened a targeted consultation on Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 on 28 September for producers, users, associations, third-country governments and exporters. Deadline: 11 October 2026, 23:59 CEST; separate responses may cover different product categories.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：尽快协调客户用实际配额、供货及成本影响提交意见，保留提交记录；咨询启动不代表配额或税率已调整。
items.impact_en: Assessment: coordinate customer evidence on quotas, supply and costs and retain submission records. Opening the consultation does not change quotas or duty rates.
items.source_excerpt: A targeted consultation seeking stakeholders' feedback on the implementation of the new EU Steel Regulation Steel producers (upstream), steel users (downstream), business associations, third country governments and exporters, and any other interested stakeholders. EU Regulation 2026/1384 establishes a tariff rate quota system to protect the Union steel market from negative trade-related effects of global overcapacity. Considering the end of the first quarter of application of the Regulation and in order to establish a strong and targeted monitoring mechanism enabling an ongoing assessment of the implementation and functioning of the Regulation, the Commission is launching this targeted consultation which aims to gather detailed information on the immediate impact on all industry potentially affected, including steel producers (upstream), steel users (downstream), business associations, third country governments and exporters, and any other interested stakeholders. Trade isn't just abo…

follow_up.action_zh: 在德国时间 10 月 11 日 23:59 前提交反馈，协调并记录客户参与情况
follow_up.action_en: Submit before 11 October 23:59 CEST and track customer participation.

items.title_zh: 欧委会发布 CBAM 核查机构资源汇总，涵盖注册与培训
items.title_en: Commission publishes a resource overview for CBAM verifiers
items.title_original: New resources available for CBAM verifiers
items.summary_zh: DG TAXUD 于 9 月 28 日的官方新闻列表说明，新资源汇总包含核查与认可指南、CBAM 注册系统访问说明、已获认可核查机构的操作文件，以及 O3CI 门户培训视频。
items.summary_en: The official DG TAXUD news listing dated 28 September describes a resource overview covering verification and accreditation guidance, registry access, operational documents for accredited verifiers and O3CI training videos.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：可作为钢厂与核查服务商确认系统访问、资料准备及配合流程的资料入口。以上依据官方新闻列表摘要，详细要求需查阅所链接文件。
items.impact_en: Monitoring assessment: use the resources to coordinate registry access, documentation and workflows with verifiers. This brief is based on the official listing; consult the linked documents for full requirements.
items.source_excerpt: 28 Sep 2026 New resources available for CBAM verifiers The Commission has published an overview of the latest resources available to support CBAM verifiers. It brings together guidance on verification and accreditation, information on access to the CBAM Registry, operational documents for Accredited Verifiers and training videos on the use of the CBAM Registry - O3CI portal. Consult the overview and access all the available resources.
items.coverage: Official news-list summary; full article not accessible during review.

items.title_zh: 美国镀锡板等调查进入最终阶段：12 月 4 日举行产业损害听证
items.title_en: US tin mill investigations: final-phase injury hearing on 4 December
items.title_original: Tin Mill Products From China, Taiwan, and Turkey; Scheduling of the Final Phase of Countervailing Duty and Antidumping Duty Investigations
items.summary_zh: USITC 公告安排中国、台湾和土耳其镀锡板等产品调查最终阶段，案号 701-TA-792、731-TA-1786-1788；范围包括镀锡及镀铬/氧化铬薄板。听证 12 月 4 日，听证申请 11 月 25 日前、庭前陈述 11 月 27 日前、庭后书面意见 12 月 11 日前；书面产品描述优先于 HTSUS 编码。
items.summary_en: USITC schedules the final phase in cases 701-TA-792 and 731-TA-1786-1788 concerning tin- and chromium-coated tin mill products. Hearing: 4 December; hearing requests: 25 November; prehearing briefs: 27 November; posthearing submissions: 11 December. Written scope controls over tariff codes.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：对美镀锡板及 TFS 业务应交由应诉团队核对产品范围、参加调查和提交期限；本公告是程序安排，没有公布最终税率。
items.impact_en: Assessment: coordinate scope and participation deadlines with counsel for US tinplate/TFS business. This is a procedural schedule, not a final duty rate.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The Commission hereby gives notice of the scheduling of the final phase of antidumping and countervailing duty investigation Nos. 701-TA-792 and 731-TA-1786-1788 (Final) pursuant to the Tariff Act of 1930 to determine whether an industry in the United States is materially injured or threatened with material injury, or the establishment of an industry in the United States is materially retarded, by reason of imports of tin mill products from China, Taiwan, and Turkey, provided for in subheadings 7210.11.00, 7210.12.00, 7210.50.00, 7212.10.00, 7212.50.00, if of non-alloy steel and under HTSUS subheadings 7225.99.00, and 7226.99.01 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, preliminarily determined by the Department of Commerce ("Commerce") to be subsidized and sold at less-than-fair-value. Commerce's preliminary determinations with respect to tin mill products from Taiwan and Turkey, alleged to be sold in the United States at less-than-fair- value, are pending.

follow_up.action_zh: 应诉团队核对参加调查登记及 APO 申请期限：公告要求不晚于听证前 21 天；后续听证申请截止 11 月 25 日
follow_up.action_en: Counsel to check appearance/APO deadlines (at least 21 days before hearing); hearing request deadline is 25 November.

items.title_zh: CBAM 核查机构培训入口更新：通过 O3CI 连接工厂与核查数据
items.title_en: CBAM verifier training resources: connect installations through O3CI
items.title_original: New training videos for accredited verifiers
items.summary_zh: 9 月 28 日新闻入口指向注册系统页。页面说明，已获认可核查机构通过 O3CI 申请登记，连接非欧盟装置、审阅排放数据与证明材料并出具核查报告；工厂与核查机构虽使用同一门户，职责不同。
items.summary_en: The 28 September resource link points to the Registry page. Accredited verifiers use O3CI to request registration, connect to non-EU installations, review emissions and supporting evidence, and issue verification reports. Operators and verifiers share a portal but perform different roles.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：协调工厂和核查服务商的账户、访问权限及资料交付，系统登记不等同于取得认可资质。
items.impact_en: Assessment: coordinate accounts, access and evidence delivery; Registry registration is distinct from accreditation.
items.source_excerpt: 28 Sep 2026 New training videos for accredited verifiers The videos provide guidance on applying to become a registered verifier, submitting requests for change, and managing collaboration requests with operators of Third Country Installations in the CBAM Registry.
items.coverage: Official Registry page reviewed; individual training videos not watched.
